links.outcome: Gender and race/ethnicity representation in AI-generated images of hospital leaders versus real-world US hospital data
links.effect: DALL-E overrepresented men (86.5%) and White individuals (94.5%); Midjourney 69.5% men, 75.0% White; Imagen 50.3% men, 51.5% White. Significant differences across models and versus real-world data.
links.quote: Artificial intelligence text-to-image models reflect and amplify systemic biases, overrepresenting men and White leaders, while underrepresenting diversity.

screen.reason: Empirical audit assessing demographic/gender/racial bias in text-to-image generative models producing representations of healthcare leadership roles.
